title: Installation Coordination Note: Ridgeline Installation Services Job Sites and Special Order Home Delivery
content:
When a Ridgeline Special Order Services item paid in full at order is delivered to an address where the customer has a Ridgeline Installation Services contract, the status of that contract sets the job-site share of the home delivery charge.

**Clause.** The job-site share depends on the customer's Ridgeline Installation Services contract whose job address is the delivery address: a contract there whose status is scheduled or in progress gives a job-site share of 0.75; a contract there whose status is measured or contracted gives 0.9; otherwise the job-site share is 1.

The home delivery charge billed is multiplied by the job-site share before its single rounding to the nearest cent; the share itself is never rounded.

## Records read

The installation contract records of the customer: the job address, which must be the delivery address of the special order, and the contract status.

## Share by contract status at the delivery address

| Ridgeline Installation Services contract at the delivery address | Job-site share |
|---|---|
| scheduled | 0.75 |
| in progress | 0.75 |
| measured | 0.9 |
| contracted | 0.9 |
| measure booked, completed, closed or cancelled | 1 |
| no contract at that address | 1 |

A contract at another address of the customer does not enter the share.

## Worked figures (hypothetical charge of 79.00 before the share)

| Contract at the delivery address | Charge |
|---|---|
| scheduled | 59.25 |
| contracted | 71.10 |
| completed | 79.00 |
